located at

  • CURIE: gmeow:locatedAt
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/locatedAt
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Relates an entity to a location it is situated at, resides in, or occurs at — geographic, virtual, or storage.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Entity -> gmeow:Location

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:locatedAt from gmeow:Entity to gmeow:Location when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Entity, gmeow:Location

Projection Coverage

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to situate any entity at a geographic, virtual, or storage location; location propagates up the containment ladder via the locatedAt ∘ containedInLocation chain.

Avoid when

  • Avoid for digital bytes resting in a store (use the narrower gmeow:storedIn) and avoid for mereological place-in-place containment (use gmeow:containedInPlace).

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:locatedAt to the most specific Location; enclosing locations are derived by the property chain, so do not also assert every ancestor by hand.

Examples

  • ex:lillith gmeow:locatedAt ex:office.
